messages:
vince (AE): Heads up — Paragon wants a 6‑week POC that uses API + Optimize + 5 Console seats. They asked for a bundled rate and a short commit. Asking for deal desk guidance on a special POC pricing path.

michelle (AM): Thanks Vince. Do we know target usage for the POC (tokens/day) and whether they require Dedicated/VPC for the POC? That will change pricing a LOT.

emma (SE): Paragon's security team just shared the questionnaire and they want SOC2 + customer-managed keys on the POC. They also mentioned bursty traffic up to ~500k tokens/day during tests. Likely Dedicated or Private.

vince (AE): Correct on keys + SOC2. They want a 6wk POC, then decide on a 12mo commit if results look good. Budget note: they signaled ~$60k for first year but want to reduce upfront.

michelle (AM): Got it. Quick proposal idea: one-time POC credits (for hosted API) + free 6w Optimize trial + 3 free Console seats, and a negotiated committed discount if they convert to 12mo. But Dedicated/VPC adds hardware costs.

ops (Onboarding): If we do Dedicated for a POC we need 2w to provision in their VPC and run network approvals. Can we keep POC on Hosted with KMS integration instead to move faster?

emma (SE): Hosted with customer KMS is possible for the scope they described (no on-prem data plane). That would avoid Dedicated provisioning delay. Security asked for HSM-level KMS — we can do KMS-backed keys with our KMS connectors, note in the questionnaire.

vince (AE): Paragon prefers Dedicated but can accept Hosted KMS to save time. They want a clear pricing path to a 12mo committed discount and a one-off POC concession.

deal-desk-bot: New deal desk request created: request_id=DD-2026-1183, submitted_by=vince, products=[API,Optimize,Console], ask=POC credits + bundle discount.

taylor (Deal Desk): Reviewing. Two tracks we can consider: (A) Hosted POC: up to $12k one-time credit + 10% bundle discount on conversion to 12mo commit >= $100k ARR. (B) Dedicated POC: no credit (infrastructure costs), but we can offer a price protection + 15% discount on conversion if they commit >= $150k ARR. Need SE confirmation on infra costs.

michelle (AM): Those ranges make sense. Can we get a short justification to present to Paragon? They want a clear number.

emma (SE): Infra estimate for a 6wk Dedicated POC: incremental GPU reservation ~ $18k, networking/provisioning ~ $4k engineering time. Hosted POC with KMS ~ minimal infra cost.

vince (AE): Paragon's CFO pushed back on $18k overhead for POC. They asked if we can reduce the financial barrier if they do a shorter Dedicated smoke test followed by Hosted full POC.

taylor (Deal Desk): We can offer a blended path: a 2wk Dedicated smoke for $6k (cost-recovery), then switch to Hosted with a $10k credit applied to conversion. Conversion incentive: 12mo commit >= $120k => 12% bundle discount + waived onboarding fee. This needs final sign-off from Legal for T&Cs.

legal-bot: Noted. If we apply credits + special discount we need a written addendum to the MSA outlining credit application, conversion trigger, and trial acceptance criteria. Low risk but requires signature.

michelle (AM): I'll message Paragon with the blended option and draft the conversion language. Vince — can you confirm they accept KMS + two-week smoke on Dedicated?

vince (AE): Confirmed. I'll push for the blended approach. Paragon wants the proposal in writing today.

ops (Onboarding): Timeline check: if they sign LOI today, we can do the 2wk smoke next Tue, Hosted POC follow immediately after. Onboarding staff assigned.

emma (SE): I'll prepare a short tech note for the questionnaire explaining hosted KMS setup and the smoke test scope.

taylor (Deal Desk): I'll provision an approval email template and preliminary rate calculations for the quote studio. If Paragon agrees to the blended flow, I'll route for a quick deal-desk approval (goal < 48h). :thumbsup:

michelle (AM): Awesome — please cc legal and ops on the proposal. Vince, ping when Paragon confirms and I'll get the quote out. :eyes: :party_popper:
